Consensus clustering of shapes in tangent PCA coordinates

Source: R/shape_ensemble.R
shape_ensemble.Rd

Clusters \(k \times m \times n\) landmark configurations with a bootstrap ensemble of k-means fits in the leading principal components of the tangent coordinates, a co-association matrix, and a spectral partition of that matrix. Unlike bagclust1, no label alignment is needed, and the result carries a real observed shape as representative of each cluster.

Usage

shape_ensemble(
  X,
  K,
  B = 30L,
  var_explained = 0.9,
  max_dim = 10L,
  seed = NULL,
  base = c("kmeans", "vii"),
  ...
)

Arguments

X

Numeric array of dimension \(k \times m \times n\), with \(m\) equal to 2 or 3.

K

Number of clusters (>= 2).

B

Number of bootstrap replicates (default 30).

var_explained

Proportion of tangent variance that fixes the number of principal components (default 0.90).

max_dim

Largest number of components kept (default 10). The number used is at least max(2, K - 1) and at most max_dim.

seed

Optional integer seed. The caller's random-number stream is restored on exit. With NULL the current stream is used.

base

Base clusterer of each replicate: "kmeans" (default, the original behavior) or "vii", the spherical-variance-per-cluster Gaussian mixture of shape_mixture (EM with 3 starts), which assigns all \(n\) observations by maximum posterior. Use "vii" when clusters have unequal spread.

...

With base = "kmeans", further arguments for kmeans in each replicate (defaults nstart = 1, iter.max = 30). Ignored for "vii".

Value

An object of class "shape_ensemble", a list with

cluster

Integer vector of length n, values in 1:K.

coassoc

The n x n co-association matrix.

dim

Number of principal components used.

representative

Integer vector of length K: index of the real observation closest to the Procrustes mean of each cluster.

centers

Array \(k \times m \times K\) with the cluster means.

B, K, var_explained, base

The options used.

n_fallback

With base = "vii", the number of replicates whose mixture fit fell back to k-means.

Details

The tangent coordinates are those of the Procrustes mean shape (shape_mean): each configuration is centered, scaled to unit size, rotated onto the mean without reflection, and projected onto the tangent space at the mean. A principal component analysis gives the scores; the smallest number of components with cumulative variance of at least var_explained is used, between max(2, K - 1) and max_dim: K groups need at least K - 1 dimensions to be separated by k-means. With K = 3 this is the earlier floor of 2.

Each replicate draws a bootstrap sample of the scores, drops duplicate rows, runs k-means with a single start, and assigns all \(n\) observations to the nearest of the \(K\) centers. The co-association matrix holds the share of replicates in which two observations get the same label. The partition is the k-means (20 starts) of the row-normalized first \(K\) eigenvectors of the symmetrically normalized matrix.

The representative of a cluster is the member with the smallest Riemannian distance \(\rho\) to the full Procrustes mean of that cluster.

See also

bagclust1, shape_kmeans

Examples

sim <- sim_shapes3d(n = 40, sigma = 1, k = 8, seed = 1)
fit <- shape_ensemble(sim$X, K = 2, B = 10, seed = 1)
fit$dim
#> [1] 2
fit$representative
#> [1] 15 55
table(sim$group, fit$cluster)
#>    
#>      1  2
#>   1 40  0
#>   2  0 40
